claim_findings.basis: Orthogonal extremal pure states and midpoint dual estimate prove oscillation contraction; no complete-contraction assumption needed.
Integrated minimum-eigenvalue inequality gives 1-(d-1)r; trace domination establishes integrability, and H_B gives direct kernel measurability. Endpoints checked.
Positive integral Choi remainder, correct scaled trace and compact feasible set; equal-reference cancellation and joint convexity/data processing yield upper factors.
Exclusion family has eta=s/(d-1), alpha_+=1-s and admissible output dimension d; this proves both sides of the exact envelope.
Circle moments, branch counts, recursive deterministic example, threshold lengths and representation dependence checked. The N-1 refinement is optional.

preserved_objections_and_qualifications.finding: Make prior general-outcome minorization and the positive-component divergence attribution more explicit. Existing broad attribution is not false.
preserved_objections_and_qualifications.requested_action: Point explicitly to Appendix A.2 general-outcome variant and the relevant adjacent results in reference [1].

preserved_objections_and_qualifications.finding: N is a valid cited sufficient constant, but the elementary finite-outcome improvement N-1 is available.
preserved_objections_and_qualifications.derivation: Choose rho_0 minimizing p_1; for a>1, min p_a >= p_a(rho_0)-r since osc(G_a)<=r osc(F_a)<=r. Sum to obtain b>=1-(N-1)r. Combining with Theorem 2 yields max(0,1-min(d-1,N-1)r).
preserved_objections_and_qualifications.requested_action: Mention this refinement or keep the comparison explicitly limited to the cited sufficient estimate. The N=100 length example remains 8.

preserved_objections_and_qualifications.finding: The broad pinned repository pointer could give exact supplement paths and replay commands. Original 1206 labels exceed direct branch-count and iteration coverage.
